FD_order: FD197 is owned before the first effect and closed before source/proc/interpreter/tool verification. Those later reads use one separately owned FD occurrence at a time, each closed before the next. No FD197 inheritance. Native FD198/199 unchanged.
code_identity: Explicit stable CodeType value projection in operator_entry._code_identity; no marshal reference flags, no claim to hash mutable module heap. Actual module/class/capture-method identity is rechecked and repeat work charged. Physical interpreter allocation remains unmeasured.

continuous_terminal_guard.after_handoff: Share.charge and spawn_attempt route to actual owner host partition; no unattributed direct source charges. The original view still guards aggregate reserve. Only the actual owner terminal_host view after enter_terminal consumes the protected suffix. Normal host source checks keep normal sublimit.
continuous_terminal_guard.clock_and_process: Share.check observes original custodian CPU/wall while no protected partition owner exists; known over-cap observations remain retained. Process attempts and completed span check include retained original native slack and terminal hold. No new span, reset, refund, or debt sum.
continuous_terminal_guard.handoff: Only actual completed EarlyResources.attach_seed_v2 registers the same owner with the view after checking same parent/share, completed transfer and exact original terminal vector. Before this succeeds, original guard remains active, including partial attachment failures.
continuous_terminal_guard.identity: View, original seven-dimensional storage, active span, epoch/deadline, original full row and conservative native slack stay unchanged. New protected_owner field is live private linkage, not wire authority.
continuous_terminal_guard.owner: BootstrapLogicalCounterView retains exact original custodian/storage; all ordinary four-dimensional writes check value + original terminal hold <= original limit before mutation.

failures: unqualified external launch: no admission; original custodian retains inherited occurrence and closes once
partial read/parse/source/proof/identity failure: retain raw first before diagnostic, all original prefixes and conservative costs, no retry
close ambiguity: clear slot before close, retainunknown, no Q1success
partial transfer: retain original owner and any created actual Share/ParentCustody; no second transfer
post-static failure: retain actual earlier captures under original preselection or selection domain
intersection: Every structural ceiling intersects all stricter already installed original root read/write/work/retained/CPU/wall/process/member/depth/FD limits. No new grant or independent fallback budget.
measurement: Static bounds/engineering controls are not native feasibility measurement; all65 gates remain open.
metadata_schedule: Reserve raw+UTF8 parse/canonical/verification copies, full source and dependency authentication including repeated bodies and EOF, all domain reports and exact tool table; complete actual canonical extents and source-defined work before effects.
native_prefix: Actual earlier native process/source/import costs are provided by qualified original observer and semantically joined to same invocation/reservation. Unknowns do not become zero; missing bound proof refuses.
pre_entry_reservation: The trusted original launch anchor carries native_preentry_reserved in all seven dimensions before any intake effect. Those conservative allocations are included in the same original spent storage first. Later actual earlier evidence must fit them; no refund or relabeling as measured. Entry setup/argument parsing gap is covered by that original qualified boundary and reserve, never free.
read_schedule: Before first read reserve ceil(B/65536)*min(B,65536)+1 logical requested bytes, the fixed body-attempt count ceil(B/65536) plus one EOF, and all corresponding buffers/work. Every returned partial is retained. A short read can exhaust that finite complete schedule and refuse; never debit only returned bytes or replay.

repeated_verifier_raw_custody.OP14_early_accessor: After the existing exact DevelopmentContract/token guard identifies contract.owner.parent, OP14 checks that actual parent.first_raw before root lookup, root/owner prechecks, source checks or charges. Every failure after parent identification passes through retain_source_failure, setting parent.first_raw and same Share._raw_first_error before secondary diagnostics. Retrying invalid or restored inputs rethrows that exact first object without another root lookup, downstream verifier, charge or command result. Invalid contracts before owning-parent identification gain no forged custody.
repeated_verifier_raw_custody.early_callers: CanonicalPublisher constructor after actual owner identification, publisher-source factory and tool-table factory own pre-capture/pre-child errors through the same parent; no future child owner required.
repeated_verifier_raw_custody.first: retain_source_failure latches ParentCustody.first_raw and same Share._raw_first_error before any projection/formatter/clock; exact exception identity, explicit None checks, and independent retention secondary.
repeated_verifier_raw_custody.limits: No claim of arbitrary Python object authenticity or native qualification. Controls use actual source definitions in invented consistent states.
repeated_verifier_raw_custody.retry: All repeated PriorStaticAdmission/RootBootstrapAdmission/source binding/tool binding/native publisher validators check the parent latch before repeat work; restored inputs or budget cannot clear it. Existing publisher capture refuses poisoned parent before any new work/slot/effect.
repeated_verifier_raw_custody.source_policy_caller: The caller parent operand remains distinct from owning_parent=self.parent. The exact caller is compared by identity with the owning parent; None, equal-looking or distinct parents refuse. Only the actual owning parent and its same Share retain the raw failure; no caller-provided error owner is used. Prior first_raw is checked before verification, and every failure rethrows the exact retained first object.

source_read_schedule: For exact bodies reserve ceil(B/65536)*min(B,65536)+1 requested bytes before open; for capped proc metadata reserve cap+1 and one body attempt plus EOF. No productive retry for short reads. Retain every returned prefix, including a positive final byte before refusal.
transfer: same spent/counter objects, original active span, origin/deadline, reservation and native prefix; no double sum, new Share.begin, refund or discarded unknown. Transfer observation is evidence of actual live transfer, never constructor authority.
